content:
I’m trained to understand and generate text (and work with images, if you send them) so I can help with a wide range of tasks, such as:

- **Answering questions & explaining concepts** (science, math, history, programming, etc.)
- **Writing and editing** (emails, essays, reports, resumes, tone rewrites, grammar)
- **Coding help** (debugging, writing functions, explaining errors, algorithms)
- **Summarizing & extracting info** from long text or documents you paste in
- **Planning & brainstorming** (project plans, study plans, trip itineraries, ideas)
- **Analyzing images** you provide (describe, identify elements, help interpret)

How I work: I learned patterns from large amounts of text (and other data) during training, but I don’t “know” things like a person does, and I can make mistakes—especially on niche, ambiguous, or rapidly changing topics—so it’s good to verify important details.

If you tell me what you want to do, I can tailor my help.
